episode.intent: For all patients who are older than 55 years old, what is the percentage of female who has abnormal prothrombin time (PT)?
episode.failed_sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN denom = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (num * 100.0 / denom) END AS percentage
FROM (
  SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
     FROM Patient p
     JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
     WHERE SUBTRACT(year(current_timestamp), year(p.Birthday)) > 55
       AND l.PT >= 14
    ) AS denom,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p2.ID)
     FROM Patient p2
     JOIN Laboratory l2 ON p2.ID = l2.ID
     WHERE SUBTRACT(year(current_timestamp), year(p2.Birthday)) > 55
       AND p2.SEX = 'F'
       AND l2.PT >= 14
    ) AS num
);
episode.remediation_sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN denom = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (num * 100.0 / denom) END AS percentage
FROM (
  SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
     FROM Patient p
     JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
     WHERE (julianday('now') - julianday(p.Birthday)) / 365.25 > 55
       AND l.PT >= 14
    ) AS denom,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p2.ID)
     FROM Patient p2
     JOIN Laboratory l2 ON p2.ID = l2.ID
     WHERE (julianday('now') - julianday(p2.Birthday)) / 365.25 > 55
       AND p2.SEX = 'F'
       AND l2.PT >= 14
    ) AS num
);
